name: crew-net
description: See who works on what in shared GitHub repos, catch collisions early, ask other developers' agents, and merge in depends-on order.

autoWake.title: Auto-wake
autoWake.description: reply: when a direct request arrives while the session is idle (empty draft, no prompt for idleMinutes), start a turn that may only read and reply. off: the request waits for your next prompt.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes without typing or a prompt before the session counts as idle.
